questions.prompt: According to the Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP), how many state-based armed conflicts (conflicts in which a government was one of the parties) were active worldwide in 2025?
questions.insight: UCDP reports this is the highest number since its records began in 1946; 13 of the conflicts were classed as wars (1,000+ battle deaths).

questions.prompt: According to Pew Research Center, what share of the world's population was religiously unaffiliated (atheist, agnostic or 'nothing in particular') in 2020?
questions.insight: Pew finds the religiously unaffiliated are the world's third-largest group after Christians (28.8%) and Muslims (25.6%).

questions.prompt: What was the global average price of a lithium-ion battery pack across all sectors in 2025, in US dollars per kilowatt-hour, according to BloombergNEF's annual survey?
questions.insight: Prices fell 8% from 2024 to a record low, with stationary-storage packs the cheapest segment at $70 per kWh.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's electricity was generated from coal in 2025, according to Ember?
questions.insight: For the first time in 100 years, renewables (33.8%) generated more of the world's electricity than coal (33.0%).

questions.prompt: According to WHO, how many people worldwide were living with dementia in 2021?
questions.insight: Nearly 10 million new dementia cases arise every year.
